```artifact
Statechart for Alarm System

1. Start
2. Idle
3. Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring
4. Blower Power Management Temperature Monitoring
5. Battery Temperature Monitoring
6. High Priority Battery Failure Alarm
7. Safety Action Invocation
8. End

Transitions:
- Idle -> Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring (on temperature sensing)
- Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring -> Blower Power Management Temperature Monitoring (on user threshold)
- Blower Power Management Temperature Monitoring -> Battery Temperature Monitoring (on user threshold)
- Battery Temperature Monitoring -> High Priority Battery Failure Alarm (on user threshold)
- High Priority Battery Failure Alarm -> Safety Action Invocation (automatic)
- Safety Action Invocation -> End (on action completion)
- Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring -> Idle (on temperature normal)
- Blower Power Management Temperature Monitoring -> Idle (on temperature normal)
- Battery Temperature Monitoring -> Idle (on temperature normal)


Statechart for GUI

1. Start
2. Idle
3. Temperature Sensing
4. Threshold Setting
5. Alarm Triggering
6. Safety Action Invocation
7. End

Transitions:
- Idle -> Temperature Sensing (on user action)
- Temperature Sensing -> Threshold Setting (on temperature reading)
- Threshold Setting -> Alarm Triggering (on threshold setting)
- Alarm Triggering -> Safety Action Invocation (on alarm)
- Safety Action Invocation -> End (on action completion)
- Temperature Sensing -> Idle (on temperature normal)

```
